verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents first-party review tools for manual review. Reviewers can override a verification's status to record their decision and blocklist documents. Collected images and extracted data are accessible. Nothing shows borderline cases being routed automatically into a review queue, or the review surface presenting images, fields and check results together. Missing for 10: automatic routing of borderline verifications into a manual review queue, documentation of a consolidated reviewer view with images, extracted fields and check results, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.

support.subject: As an ops lead, borderline verifications land in a manual review queue with the full evidence — document images, extracted fields, check results — and reviewer decisions feed back into the record

citations.quote: you can perform manual reviews to provide an extra layer of fraud protection.
Override status: Manually override the verification status to match your decision on whether or not the customer is verified.
Access collected images, and extracted data from government-issued ID documents
